nodes.name: Monthly (2nd, 07:00) — disabled
nodes.notes: Enable only after a full month has been run in parallel with the manual process and every number matched.

nodes.name: 00 · Preflight
nodes.notes: Checks .env.local is complete, S3 is reachable, the Convin token is live, and the output disk has room. Cheap, and it fails here instead of an hour into stage 03.

nodes.name: 01 · Fetch from S3
nodes.notes: Books + status files. Records each object's Date Added as the load date S — authoritative, never inferred from the filename. Skips what it already has, so re-running is free.

nodes.name: 02 · Plan + campaign assignment
nodes.notes: Reads cached assignments from state/campaigns.json. If every book name is known, it plans and continues. If any book is new — or plan_month.mjs emits any warning — it exits 10 and the run stops for a human. This is the one deliberate stop in the pipeline.

parameters.subject: =RBL {{ $json.month }} — campaign assignment needed before the run can continue
parameters.message:
=The month cannot be planned without a decision.

UNASSIGNED BOOKS ({{ ($json.unassigned || []).length }}):
{{ ($json.unassigned || []).map(b => `  ${b.book}   loaded ${b.loadDate}` + (b.suggestion ? `   (last month this name was: ${b.suggestion})` : '   (new name — never seen before)')).join('\n') }}

PLANNER WARNINGS ({{ ($json.warnings || []).length }}):
{{ ($json.warnings || []).join('\n') }}

WHY THIS STOPS THE RUN
Campaign decides which status file each book is paired with, and the two use
different outcome vocabularies — PreX is Resolved/Unresolved, Bucket is
Unresolved/Normalisation/STAB/RB. Pair a book with the wrong one and every number
on the report renders and every number is wrong.

TO CONTINUE
1. Edit  {{ $vars.RBL_REPO }}/state/campaigns.json
2. Add an entry per book:  "CYC 17 Convin": { "campaign": "bucket", "days": 5 }
3. Re-run this workflow. Stages 00 and 01 will skip what they already fetched.

nodes.name: Email — assignment needed
nodes.notes: Swap for SMTP or Slack if you don't use Gmail. Credentials live in n8n, never in this file.

parameters.errorMessage: =Stopped for campaign assignment — {{ ($json.unassigned || []).length }} book(s) unassigned, {{ ($json.warnings || []).length }} planner warning(s). See the email for what to edit.

nodes.name: 03a · List cohorts
nodes.notes: One pull per (campaign, load date), not one per day — a cohort export contains every day, sliced later by Call Timestamp. This is what took July from 61 exports down to 21.

nodes.name: For each cohort
nodes.notes: Batch size 1. Output 'done' (top) continues to stage 05; output 'loop' (bottom) runs one cohort.

nodes.name: 03b · Export one cohort
nodes.notes: Trigger, verify request_params server-side, then poll until the job clears. The script owns the retry policy (cap ~20 min, re-fire, escalate after N) — deliberately NOT duplicated as an n8n retry, so there is only one place that decides when to give up.

nodes.name: 04 · Collect + repair
nodes.notes: Fetches the CSV from EMAIL, not the in-app notification — that one is websocket-only, held in memory, and single-use: one click consumes it and a reload wipes it. Then runs repair_calllog.mjs, whose non-zero exit is fatal.

nodes.name: 05 · Assemble folder tree
nodes.notes: Slices each cohort log into <book>/Day N - <date>/{1,2,3}. A missing status file builds the days that exist and records the gap — it never silently drops the book. July hit exactly this with Bucket Status 26 July.

nodes.name: 06 · Build PDFs
nodes.notes: Wraps `npm run reports`. 20–40 minutes for a full month. Each book is pushed to the scratch date, exported, then deleted before the next.

nodes.name: 07 · Verify
nodes.notes: Independent of the build log — it re-reads the artefacts. Account counts vs the book file, zero-attempt detection, cohort totals never exceeded, PDF header and EOF.

nodes.name: Acquire the month lock
nodes.notes: The __EXIT__ sentinel is load-bearing. Measured on n8n 2.35.7: this node reports exitCode ONLY when the command exits 0 — on any non-zero exit it emits { error } alone, dropping exitCode AND stdout. lock.mjs exits 10 for "someone else holds this month", which is a decision, not a crash. Without the sentinel that is indistinguishable from a failure. Do not tidy it away.
